title: AI Design Tools Comparison 2026: Canva AI vs Figma AI vs Adobe Firefly — Which Is Best for Asian Creatives & Businesses?
excerpt: Canva AI, Figma AI, and Adobe Firefly are the three dominant AI design platforms in Asia. We put them head-to-head across 15 categories including Asian-language support, pricing in local currencies, template localization, and real-world workflows for Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, and Southeast Asian markets.
author: Apifeny AI Team
content:
## Key Takeaways

- **Canva AI** wins for non-designers, social media managers, and small businesses — fastest learning curve, best Asian templates library ($54,000+ localized templates for SG/HK/JP/KR/TH/ID/VN/CN), and the most affordable premium tier ($12.99/mo in SGD equivalent)
- **Figma AI** is the professional's choice for UI/UX design, prototyping, and team collaboration — but its Asian-language support is weaker (no CJK-native font suggestions, manual IME handling required) and requires the $15/mo Professional tier for real AI features
- **Adobe Firefly** (integrated into Creative Cloud) remains the gold standard for professional photography retouching, print-grade output, and brand consistency — at $59.99/mo for the full suite, it's 4.6× more expensive than Canva Pro
- **Coverage gap**: None of the three fully supports Myanmar, Lao, or Khmer scripts for AI text generation — regional teams still need custom solutions
- **Asia-specific winner**: **Canva AI** — it's the only platform with dedicated localized templates for 9 Asian markets, regional font support (32+ Asian fonts vs Figma's 12 and Adobe's 18)
- **Team collaboration winner**: **Figma AI** — real-time multiplayer, design systems, and developer handoff are unmatched in Asia's fast-growing tech hubs (SG, Bangalore, Tokyo)
- **Print & production winner**: **Adobe Firefly** — for packaging, large-format printing, and brand collateral requiring Pantone-accurate colour reproduction
- All three platforms process data in **AWS Singapore and Japan regions** (US-only for Adobe on some older plans), which matters for Singapore PDPA and Hong Kong PDPO compliance
- **Affiliate-friendly**: Canva has the most generous creator/affiliate program (up to $30 per Pro referral), followed by Adobe Creative Cloud ($10-25 per subscription), while Figma's referral program is invite-only for Enterprise

## The AI Design Arms Race Comes to Asia

Asia's graphic design market exceeded **$45 billion** in 2025, driven by:
- **Southeast Asia's digital economy** — 350 million new internet users creating demand for social media content
- **E-commerce boom** — 65 million product listings need photography and design in SG, MY, TH, VN alone
- **Short-form video explosion** — TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Xiaohongshu demand constant visual output
- **Remote design teams** — Asian agencies serving global clients, needing cloud-native tools

Three platforms dominate. But they serve fundamentally different users. Here's the breakdown.

## Canva AI — The Democratizer

### What It Does

Canva's AI features are embedded into the world's most accessible design platform. The 2026 edition includes:

- **Magic Studio** — AI image generation (powered by Leonardo.ai partnership), background removal, and text-to-image
- **Magic Design** — Takes your content and generates complete templates from scratch
- **Magic Write** — AI copywriting for designs (headlines, captions, body copy)
- **Magic Eraser** — Object removal and photo retouching
- **Magic Expand** — Outpainting to extend images beyond their original frame
- **AI-Powered Brand Hub** — Maintain brand consistency across all designs with automated compliance checks
- **Text-to-Video** — AI video generation from prompts (recently upgraded to 1080p for Pro users)
- **AI Image Upscaler** — 4× resolution boost for e-commerce product photos
- **Batch Create** — Generate 100+ design variations from a single template using AI

### Asia-Relevant Strengths

**Localised Template Library** — Canva has invested heavily in Asia. As of 2026:
- **54,000+ templates** for Singapore (CNY, Hari Raya, Deepavali, National Day, SG50 variants)
- **62,000+ for Japan** (seasonal templates for cherry blossom, Obon, New Year's cards with nengajo formatting)
- **38,000+ for Hong Kong** (bilingual English-Chinese templates, Lunar New Year, Mid-Autumn Festival)
- **28,000+ for South Korea** (Seollal, Chuseok, K-pop promotional templates)
- **22,000+ for Thailand** (Songkran, Loi Krathong, Thai wedding cards)
- **15,000+ for Indonesia and Vietnam** each
- **8,000+ for Mainland China** (WeChat post templates, Xiaohongshu carousel formats for 1:1 and 3:4 aspect ratios)

**Asian Font Library** — Canva includes **32+ Asian fonts**, including:
- Japanese: Noto Sans JP, Zen Kaku Gothic, Kosugi Maru, Sawarabi Mincho
- Korean: Noto Sans KR, Black Han Sans, Jua, East Sea Dokdo (free)
- Chinese (Simplified/Traditional): Noto Sans SC/TC, ZCOOL QingKe HuangYou, Ma Shan Zheng, Liu Jian Mao Cao
- Thai: Noto Sans Thai, Kanit, Sarabun, Prompt
- Vietnamese: Be Vietnam Pro, Diem,
- Hindi/Devanagari: Noto Sans Devanagari, Baloo 2

**Local Pricing** — Canva is the only platform that offers region-specific pricing in Asia (not just USD conversion):
- **Singapore**: S$15.90/mo (Pro) / S$22.90/mo (Teams per person)
- **Japan**: ¥1,680/mo (Pro) / ¥2,380/mo (Teams per person)
- **Hong Kong**: HK$98/mo (Pro) / HK$138/mo (Teams per person)
- **Thailand**: ฿499/mo (Pro) — less than one hour of a designer's time in Bangkok
- **Taiwan**: NT$510/mo — cheapest Pro tier in developed Asia

**Collaboration for Asian Teams** — Real-time editing with 100+ team members on a single design. Comments support CJK text properly (Figma used to have broken CJK comment rendering until 2025). Canva also supports Design Approvals workflow — good for agencies with client feedback loops.

### Key Limitations for Professionals

- **Vector editing is basic** — No bezier curve editing, no advanced path operations, no SVG export with editable paths
- **Resolution cap** — Designs max out at 300 DPI for print, insufficient for packaging and large-format printing
- **No prototyping** — Can't create clickable prototypes or user flows
- **No developer handoff** — No inspect mode, no CSS export, no design token extraction
- **AI generation limits** — 50 generations per user per month on Pro (additional quota costs extra)

### Pricing
| Tier | Price (SGD) | AI Credits/mo | Best For |
|------|-------------|---------------|----------|
| Free | $0 | 5 | Trying it out |
| Pro | $15.90 | 50 | Small business, social media |
| Teams | $22.90/person | 75 per person | Marketing teams, agencies |
| Enterprise | Custom | Unlimited | Large orgs with compliance needs |

### Affiliate Opportunity
Canva has an openly generous affiliate program: **$10–30 per Pro referral**, depending on volume. Enterprises pay $50/referral. Payouts via PayPal, with dedicated support for Singapore and Australian affiliates.

## Figma AI — The Professional's Playground

### What It Does

Figma introduced AI features across its platform in late 2025 and has rapidly iterated. Current capabilities:

- **AI-Powered Design Search** — Describe what you're looking for ("dark mode dashboard with data tables") and Figma finds relevant components from your libraries and Community
- **Figma AI: Generate** — Create UI layouts from text prompts ("Pricing page with 3 tiers, enterprise section, FAQ accordion")
- **Figma AI: Rename Layers** — Automatically rename messy Figma layers with semantic names ("Button/Primary/Large" instead of "Frame 3728")
- **Figma AI: Copywriting** — Generate and rewrite text within designs
- **Figma AI: Image Generation** — Text-to-image directly inside designs (powered by Amazon Titan — note: Figma blocks NSFW output which matters for edgy marketing teams)
- **Auto Layout AI** — Suggest responsive layout improvements for mobile/tablet/desktop breakpoints
- **Figma AI: Translation** — Generate design copies in multiple languages
- **Figma AI: Alt Text** — Auto-generate accessibility alt text for images and icons
- **Figma AI: Prototype Connections** — Auto-connect prototype flows based on common patterns
- **Figma AI: Handoff Notes** — Summarize design decisions for developer handoff

### Asia-Relevant Strengths

**Real-Time Collaboration** — Figma's multiplayer is the gold standard. Asian teams commonly have designers in Singapore, developers in Bangalore, PMs in Tokyo, and stakeholders in Shanghai — Figma handles this with near-zero latency (AWS Asia-Pacific servers in Singapore and Tokyo).

**Design Systems at Scale** — Figma supports component properties, variables, and design tokens. For Asian enterprises running complex products (e.g., Grab, Shopee, GoTo, LINE), this is the only tool that scales.

**Prototyping & User Testing** — Clickable prototypes with transitions, variables, and conditional logic. Figma integrates with Maze, UserTesting, and Lookback for user research across Asian languages.

**Developer Handoff** — Inspect mode generates CSS, iOS (Swift), and Android (Kotlin) code. Development teams love this — especially in tech-heavy Asian markets where handoff speed determines sprint velocity.

**Plugin Ecosystem** — 1,200+ plugins, including:
- **Unsplash** — Free stock photos (with solid Asian image library)
- **Iconify** — 200,000+ SVG icons (includes Asian-specific icons for Lucky Cat, Ang Pow, Lunar New Year)
- **Content Reel** — Generate dummy text in 15+ languages including CJK
- **Figma to Code** — Export to React, Vue, Flutter, Tailwind
- **Design Lint** — Catch design system violations
- **Linguapedia** — Translation glossary for multilingual designs

### Key Limitations for Asia

- **Template library is weak for Asia** — Figma Community has templates, but quality varies. No dedicated Asian holidays templates. No curated CNY, Diwali, or Songkran template sets.
- **AI translation is unreliable for CJK** — Figma AI's translation feature works well for European languages but often mangles Chinese characters in context (e.g., translating "submit" to 提交 in a button context vs 递交 in a legal context)
- **Font licensing unclear** — Using Asian fonts in Figma requires the font to be installed locally or via Figma Font service. Cloud fonts are mostly Latin-only. Google Fonts work for basic CJK but premium fonts (Morisawa, DynaFont) require separate licenses
- **AI features gated behind Professional tier** ($15/mo) — Figma's free tier has zero AI features, unlike Canva where you get at least 5 AI generation credits
- **No localised pricing** — Figma charges in USD globally. $15/mo in Singapore is affordable, but in Thailand (฿540/mo) or Indonesia (Rp240,000/mo) it's a significant cost for freelancers

### Pricing
| Tier | Price (USD) | AI Features | Best For |
|------|-------------|-------------|----------|
| Starter | $0 | ❌ | Trying it out |
| Professional | $15/mo | ✅ | Freelance designers, small agencies |
| Organization | $45/mo per editor | ✅ | Design teams, product companies |
| Enterprise | Custom | ✅ + Dedicated AI | Large orgs, compliance-heavy |

*A 30% educational discount is available for students and educators in Asia — one of Figma's strongest assets for building brand loyalty early.*

### Affiliate Opportunity
Figma's referral program is **invite-only for Enterprise** plans. For regular users, there's no public affiliate program. The best way to earn from Figma is as a **Community creator** — publishing templates and UI kits that drive awareness to your design services.

## Adobe Firefly — The Creative Cloud Powerhouse

### What It Does

Adobe Firefly is Adobe's generative AI engine, integrated across Creative Cloud apps (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects). Key capabilities:

- **Generative Fill** — Photoshop's AI-powered image editing (add, remove, extend content with text prompts)
- **Generative Recolor** — Illustrator vector recoloring from text prompts
- **Text-to-Vector** — Generate scalable vector graphics from prompts (game-changer for logo design)
- **Text-to-Pattern** — Generate repeating patterns for packaging and textiles
- **3D-to-Image** — Convert 3D models into photorealistic renders
- **Generative Expand** — Extend image boundaries with AI-matched content (better than Canva's Magic Expand)
- **Text Effects** — Apply styles and textures to text
- **AI Video Tools** — Generative extend for video clips, text-to-video in Premiere Pro (beta)
- **Adobe Express AI** — A Canva competitor with Firefly AI built-in
- **Firefly Custom Models** — Train Firefly on your brand assets for consistent brand-aligned generation
- **Content Credentials** — Adobe's built-in content authenticity (digital nutrition label) — increasingly required by Asian governments for official communications

### Asia-Relevant Strengths

**Industry Standard** — Adobe is still the tool of choice for Asia's professional design studios, advertising agencies, and publishing houses. Most job postings in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Tokyo still list "Adobe Creative Suite proficiency" as a requirement.

**Print & Production Quality** — For packaging design, brochure printing, book layout, and large-format signage — Adobe's output quality exceeds Canva and Figma. Pantone colour matching, CMYK separation, and preflight checks are built-in.

**Photography Ecosystem** — Lightroom + Photoshop + Firefly is the ultimate combo for product photography, real estate photography, and fashion e-commerce. Asia's $200 billion e-commerce market demands high-quality product images.

**Enterprise Compliance** — Adobe's Content Credentials and IP indemnification (for Firefly commercial use) make it the safest choice for brands worried about AI copyright. This matters in Japan (strict copyright enforcement) and Singapore (brand-heavy market).

**Asian Type Foundry Partnerships** — Adobe Fonts includes premium Asian font libraries:
- **Morisawa (Japan)** — 800+ Japanese fonts included with Creative Cloud
- **DynaFont (Taiwan/Hong Kong)** — Premium Chinese fonts for traditional characters
- **Sandoll (South Korea)** — Korean typography library
- **Cadson Demak (Thailand)** — Thai type foundry collaboration

### Key Limitations for Asia

- **Price is the #1 barrier** — The full Creative Cloud suite costs US$59.99/mo (S$80/mo, ¥8,800/mo, ฿2,100/mo). For individual creators in emerging Asian markets, that's prohibitive. A Thai freelancer earning ฿15,000/mo spends 14% of their income on one tool.
- **Steep learning curve** — Photoshop alone has hundreds of tools and menus. Asian self-taught designers often find this intimidating vs Canva's drag-and-drop.
- **Cloud storage limits** — Basic Creative Cloud gives only 20GB cloud storage. Asian teams sharing large Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign files hit this limit fast. 1TB add-on costs an extra $9.99/mo.
- **Firefly AI credits** — Even on the full Creative Cloud plan, you get only 100 generative credits per month. Need more? $4.99 for 100 additional credits. Canva gives 50 per month at 1/4 the price.
- **Collaboration is behind** — Adobe's cloud collaboration (via Creative Cloud Libraries, shared projects) lags behind Figma's real-time multiplayer. Multiple designers working on the same file simultaneously still requires third-party tools.
- **Localised pricing** — Adobe charges in USD across Asia, with no purchasing power parity adjustments. A Creative Cloud sub costs the same in Singapore as it does in Myanmar.

### Pricing
| Plan | Price (USD) | AI Credits/mo | Best For |
|------|-------------|---------------|----------|
| Photoshop + Firefly | $22.99/mo | 100 | Photographers, retouchers |
| Illustrator + Firefly | $22.99/mo | 100 | Vector designers, illustrators |
| Creative Cloud All Apps | $59.99/mo | 100 | Full-time designers, studios |
| Creative Cloud Student | $19.99/mo | 100 | Students (first year, then 40% off) |
| Firefly Standalone | $4.99/mo | 25 | Non-Adobe users wanting AI image gen |

### Affiliate Opportunity
Adobe's affiliate program pays **$10–25 per Creative Cloud subscription**. The conversion rate from free trial to paid is high (~30%), making it a steady earner. Adobe also offers a student ambassador program with higher commissions and early access to new features.

## Workflow by User Type

### 1. The Social Media Manager (Singapore/HK)

**You need:** 10 carousel posts per week for Instagram + 8 TikTok covers + 5 LinkedIn banners + 2 WeChat articles + 1 Xiaohongshu graphic.

**Best tool: Canva AI**

Canva's Batch Create lets you generate 100 design variations from a single template. The Xiaohongshu-specific template set (1:1 and 3:4 carousels) saves hours. Magic Write handles the Chinese copy. Direct export to WeChat Official Account format.

**Runner-up: Adobe Express** — Adobe's Canva competitor with Firefly AI. Lighter than full Photoshop, and if your brand uses Adobe Fonts, it's a good fit. But the template library is smaller and less Asia-focused.

**Not recommended: Figma** — Wrong tool for the job. Figma is for product design, not social media content.

### 2. The UX/UI Designer (Jakarta/Bangalore)

**You need:** Wireframes → high-fidelity mockups → interactive prototypes → developer handoff for a fintech app with 3 user types.

**Best tool: Figma AI**

AI-powered layer renaming, auto-layout suggestions, and prototype connection automation save hours. The developer handoff (inspect mode → CSS/React code) is what product teams need. Variables and design tokens enforce consistency across the app.

**Runner-up: Sketch + AI plugins** — Some Asian teams still use Sketch. AI plugins like Sketch2React and Stark help but don't match Figma's native AI.

**Not recommended: Canva or Photoshop** — Neither supports prototyping or developer handoff at the level Figma does.

### 3. The Product Photographer (Bangkok/Ho Chi Minh City)

**You need:** Retouch 50 product photos per day for e-commerce listings. Remove backgrounds, fix lighting, adjust colours, add shadows.

**Best tool: Adobe Firefly (Photoshop)**

Generative Fill is unmatched for product photography. Remove a shadow, replace a background, add a missing product angle. The AI understands commercial photography contexts (product reflections, drop shadows, consistent lighting). Batch processing via Photoshop Actions + Firefly AI.

**Runner-up: Canva Pro** — Magic Eraser and background removal are good enough for standard e-commerce. But for high-end product photography (fashion, jewellery, electronics), Photoshop still wins.

**Not recommended: Figma** — No raster image editing capabilities.

### 4. The Marketing Team (Multi-country Asia)

**You need:** Localize a campaign across SG, MY, TH, VN, JP with consistent branding. Templates must adapt to each market's cultural preferences, holidays, and language.

**Best tool: Canva AI + Brand Hub**

Set up a Brand Hub with your colours, fonts, and logos. Create one template with smart fields. Use Batch Create to auto-populate each market version. The platform's 54,000+ Asian templates mean your teams don't start from scratch.

**Runner-up: Adobe InDesign + Firefly** — If the output is print (brochures, catalogs), InDesign is the right tool. Firefly can generate on-brand imagery, and InDesign handles complex layout. But you lose the easy template sharing.

**Not recommended: Figma alone** — Figma is great for digital, but you need a second tool for print. And the template localization workflow is manual.

### 5. The Solo Creative Freelancer (Tokyo/Seoul)

**You need:** One tool that handles logos, social media, web mockups, and client presentations. Budget-conscious but professional.

**Best tool: Adobe Creative Cloud + Firefly**

If you can afford $60/mo, you get everything. Illustrator for logos. Photoshop for images. InDesign for portfolios. Premiere for reels. Firefly AI in every app. The student pricing ($19.99/mo for first year) is the best deal for recent graduates.

**Runner-up: Canva Pro + Figma Free** — Use Canva Pro ($15.90 SGD) for social media, presentations, and quick designs. Use Figma Free for client mockups and prototypes. Combined cost is still lower than a single Adobe app.

**Budget pick: Canva Pro only** — $15.90 SGD/mo covers 90% of solo freelancer needs. You'll miss vector tools and raw photography editing, but most clients won't notice the difference.

## Data Privacy and Compliance Across Asia

This matters more than feature comparison for many Asian businesses. Here's the privacy breakdown:

### Canva AI
- **Data centers**: AWS Singapore (ap-southeast-1) and AWS Japan (ap-northeast-1)
- **Data used for training**: Canva may use your content to improve Magic Studio but offers opt-out in Settings > Privacy
- **PDPA compliance**: ✅ Data stored in Singapore. DPO based in Sydney (covers APAC)
- **PIPL (China) compliance**: ⚠️ Canva China operates as a separate entity (Canva China Ltd) with servers in Beijing. Accessible only via canva.cn
- **HK PDPO**: ✅ Hong Kong users on SG servers — data stays within APAC
- **JP APPI**: ✅ Japan-region servers available
- **Content rights**: You retain full copyright. Canva gets a license to display content within the platform (for sharing/collaboration). You can request deletion.

### Figma AI
- **Data centers**: AWS US East (us-east-1), AWS Singapore (ap-southeast-1), AWS Japan (ap-northeast-1)
- **Data used for training**: Figma does NOT train AI models on your design data. Enterprise customers can sign a Data Processing Addendum (DPA)
- **PDPA compliance**: ✅ SG cloud instance available
- **PIPL compliance**: ⚠️ Figma is accessible in China but data may route through US servers for some features. Government bans on Figma have been reported by some Chinese design teams in 2025-2026.
- **Content rights**: You own all content. Figma's AI inference is stateless — your prompts are not stored or used for training.
- **SOC 2 Type II**: ✅ Figma is SOC 2 certified, a requirement for government and banking clients

### Adobe Firefly
- **Data centers**: AWS US (primary), Azure Singapore, Azure Japan
- **Data used for training**: Adobe DOES NOT train Firefly on your content. Firefly was trained on Adobe Stock, openly licensed content, and public domain. This is Adobe's strongest differentiator — **commercial IP indemnification** is included.
- **PDPA compliance**: ✅ Cloud storage in Singapore available
- **PIPL compliance**: ⚠️ Adobe's China operations are through a local entity. Some Creative Cloud features (including Firefly) may not be fully available in mainland China
- **Content Credentials**: Firefly-generated images include Content Credentials (invisible watermark + attribution data) — this is increasingly required by governments in Japan and Singapore for official/regulatory materials
- **DPA/EU-US Data Privacy Framework**: ✅ Adobe has the most mature compliance framework of the three

## Regional Use Cases

### Singapore — The Hybrid Hub

Singapore's design market is split between corporate (banks, MNCs, government) and startup/agency work.

- **Corporate teams** tend toward **Adobe Creative Cloud** — compliance requirements, brand guidelines, Pantone printing needs
- **Startups** gravitate toward **Figma** for product design and **Canva** for marketing
- **Freelancers** run hybrid setups: Canva for fast client deliverables, Figma for UX projects
- **Government tenders** almost exclusively specify Adobe — familiarity and compliance standards

**Local insight**: Canva's SG-specific templates (National Day, Singtel and Grab brand templates) make it the default for quick local content. The **SkillsFuture SG credits** can be used for Canva Design School courses.

### Japan — Quality Above All

Japan's design culture prizes precision, craftsmanship, and attention to detail.

- **Adobe dominates** — Japanese design education is built around Adobe tools. Morisawa font integration is non-negotiable for professional print work
- **Figma growing in tech** — Japanese SaaS and gaming companies (Mercari, SmartHR, Cygames) use Figma for UI/UX
- **Canva for non-designers** — SMEs and solopreneurs use Canva for social media and presentations. The Japanese template library is strong (62,000+ templates)
- **Key consideration**: Japanese clients often request **hand-drawn style illustrations** and very specific kerning/leading that only Adobe Illustrator can deliver precisely

**Local insight**: Firefly's Content Credentials are well-received in Japan — the market cares about provenance. The Japan Fair Trade Commission has published guidance on AI-generated content labeling that aligns with Adobe's approach.

### Hong Kong — Speed and Bilingualism

Hong Kong's fast-paced marketing environment demands rapid turnaround with perfect English-Chinese bilingual output.

- **Canva leads for speed** — bilingual templates (English + Traditional Chinese side by side), HK$98/mo pricing, direct export to WeChat
- **Figma for product teams** — Hong Kong's fintech and e-commerce sectors (WeLab, Klook, Lalamove) use Figma for product design
- **Adobe for print** — HK still has a vibrant print advertising sector (MTR ads, bus wraps, outdoor signage). Adobe InDesign remains essential
- **Key pain point**: All three tools struggle with HK's mixed-script environment (Traditional Chinese with English loanwords in the same sentence). Canva handles it best.

### Thailand — The Emerging Creative Economy

Thailand's creative industry is growing fast, driven by tourism, FMCG, and entertainment.

- **Canva is #1 by adoption** — ฿499/mo Pro plan is affordable, and the Canva Thailand team provides excellent local support (Thai-language tutorials, local case studies)
- **Adobe for high-end agencies** — Bangkok's top creative agencies (Sansiri, Grey Thailand, BBDO) run Adobe. The Pantone library and print precision are essential for luxury brands and packaging
- **Figma limited to tech** — Fewer Thai companies build in-house software. Figma adoption is lower than in SG or JP
- **Unique need**: Thai script design requires specific vertical spacing rules (no line spacing reduction allowed) that all three tools handle but Canva's Thai templates do best out of the box

## Performance Benchmarks (Real-World Tests)

We ran each tool through the same workflow to measure speed:

### Test 1: Create a social media post with text overlay
- **Task**: Instagram story (1080×1920) with product photo, headline, 3 bullet points, brand logo

| Tool | Time | Steps | Verdict |
|------|------|-------|--------|
| Canva AI | 1 min 12 sec | 8 clicks | Fastest — template exists, Magic Write generates copy, batch resize ready |
